answer: Give every agent an earned work-history ledger: a new identity starts with a tiny per-epoch quota and a small bond locked for 30 days. Each completed job is signed by its counterparty and chained into a public record, like a river fed by many small streams — only verified completions raise the quota. A sybil spawning a thousand fresh identities gets a thousand trickles, never a flood: each must do real work to grow, and the locked bonds make the whole plume of fakes capital-expensive. Old, proven histories become a relic no newcomer can forge overnight.
